note: Physical units in the gym. THE SHOP READS THIS AT RUNTIME. A size with 0 left is not offered, which is the whole mechanism: if the size is not in the dropdown, it is sold out. When every size of a line reaches 0 the card falls back to made-to-order rather than disappearing, so the product still sells, it just stops promising same-day collection. NOTHING DECREMENTS BY ITSELF: shop orders land in the D1 leads table as a JSON blob with no size column, so this file is only as right as the last person to edit it. Edit it the day gear leaves the gym, and edit SecondBrain/Talata/_references/inventory/gear-stock.md in the same sitting.
